notes: Values for B300, GB300 NVL72, MI300X and MI325X memory/bandwidth/power were fetched from primary vendor sources (see per-field sources); per-field labels mark those fields published. Other values were checked only against search excerpts and stay modeled. psu_ceiling_kw is active PSUs x PSU rating for a named OEM server (from the OEM page in psu_ceiling_source); it is a ceiling, not a measured draw, and modeled unit power must not exceed it. Dense TFLOPS = vendor sparse figure / 2 unless the vendor gives a dense figure. Platform per-GPU values = platform total / GPU count.

gpus.label: modeled

gpus.name: AMD Instinct MI355X
gpus.label: modeled
gpus.notes: Liquid-cooled 8-GPU system. AMD lists BF16 2.5 PF, OCP-FP8 5 PF and MXFP4 10.1 PF; treated as dense (AMD lists sparse separately), but the excerpt did not confirm the dense/sparse basis. 288 GB HBM3E, 8 TB/s. Only the 1,400 W board power is published; server power estimated as 8 x 1.4 + 2.5 kW = 13.7 kW. softwareEfficiency stays at the 0.8 default. AMD's own MLPerf Inference 6.0/6.1 blog posts exist but were not fetched. Values match the vendor page per web-search excerpts; the page itself could not be fetched (egress blocked), so the record is labeled modeled pending a direct fetch. Unit power 13.0 kW is an estimate (no OEM publishes max system power). PSU ceiling: Supermicro AS -4126GS-NMR-LCC (liquid, direct-to-chip): 4 x 6600 W, 2+2 redundant, so 2 active x 6.6 kW = 13.2 kW at 239-240 VAC. At 200-207.9 VAC each PSU is rated 5900 W, so the ceiling is 11.8 kW, below the 13 kW estimate.
